import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_N = 70;
    static final int MAX_M = 50;
    static final int LIMIT = 22;

    static long[][] C = new long[MAX_N + 5][MAX_N + 5];

    static void init() {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; ++i) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
                C[i][j] = C[i-1][j-1] + C[i-1][j];
            }
        }
    }

    static int n, m, N;
    static int mid;
    static int[] g = new int[MAX_N + 5];

    static List<long[]>[] memo_b = new List[MAX_M + 5][MAX_M + 5];
    static Map<Long, Long>[] memo_a = new Map[MAX_M + 5][MAX_M + 5];

    static long best_val = Long.MAX_VALUE;
    static long best_cnt = 0;

    static void update(long val, long cnt) {
        if (val < best_val) {
            best_val = val;
            best_cnt = cnt;
        } else if (val == best_val) {
            best_cnt += cnt;
        }
    }

    static void dfs(int pos, int ca, int cb, long sum) {
        if (pos == mid) {
            memo_b[ca][cb].add(new long[]{sum, 1});
            return;
        }
        for (int c = 0; c < 2; ++c) {
            if (g[pos-1] != -1 && c != g[pos-1]) continue;
            long add = 0;
            if (c == 0 && ca > 0) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                    add += C[ca-1][n-1] * C[cb][j] * C[N-pos][n-j];
                }
                dfs(pos-1, ca-1, cb, sum + add);
            } else if (c == 1 && cb > 0) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                    add -= C[cb-1][n-1] * C[ca][j] * C[N-pos][n-j];
                }
                dfs(pos-1, ca, cb-1, sum + add);
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfs() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n+m; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n+m; ++j) {
                memo_a[i][j].clear();
            }
        }
        memo_a[0][0].put(0L, 1L);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= n+m; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n+m; ++j) {
                for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : memo_a[i][j].entrySet()) {
                    long cur = entry.getKey();
                    long cnt = entry.getValue();
                    if (i + j == mid) {
                        List<long[]> list = memo_b[i][j];
                        long target = -cur;
                        int idx = Collections.binarySearch(list, new long[]{target, 0}, (a, b) -> Long.compare(a[0], b[0]));
                        if (idx < 0) idx = -idx - 1;
                        if (idx < list.size()) {
                            update(Math.abs(cur + list.get(idx)[0]), cnt * list.get(idx)[1]);
                        }
                        if (idx > 0) {
                            update(Math.abs(cur + list.get(idx-1)[0]), cnt * list.get(idx-1)[1]);
                        }
                    } else {
                        int idx = i + j;
                        for (int c = 0; c < 2; ++c) {
                            if (g[idx] != -1 && c != g[idx]) continue;
                            int na = i, nb = j;
                            if (c == 0) ++na;
                            else ++nb;
                            if (na <= n+m && nb <= n+m) {
                                long delta = 0;
                                if (c == 0) {
                                    for (int l = 0; l < n; ++l) {
                                        delta += C[na-1][n-1] * C[nb][l] * C[N-idx-1][n-l];
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    for (int l = 0; l < n; ++l) {
                                        delta -= C[nb-1][n-1] * C[na][l] * C[N-idx-1][n-l];
                                    }
                                }
                                memo_a[na][nb].put(cur + delta, memo_a[na][nb].getOrDefault(cur + delta, 0L) + cnt);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void solve() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n+m; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n+m; ++j) {
                memo_b[i][j].clear();
            }
        }
        dfs(N, n+m, n+m, 0);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= n+m; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n+m; ++j) {
                Collections.sort(memo_b[i][j], (a, b) -> Long.compare(a[0], b[0]));
                List<long[]> tmp = new ArrayList<>();
                int sz = memo_b[i][j].size();
                for (int k = 0; k < sz; ) {
                    long val = memo_b[i][j].get(k)[0];
                    long total = 0;
                    while (k < sz && memo_b[i][j].get(k)[0] == val) {
                        total += memo_b[i][j].get(k)[1];
                        ++k;
                    }
                    tmp.add(new long[]{val, total});
                }
                memo_b[i][j] = tmp;
            }
        }
        bfs();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        init();
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        m = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        String s = br.readLine();
        
        N = (n + m) * 2;
        mid = Math.max(0, N - LIMIT);
        Arrays.fill(g, -1);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= n+m; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n+m; ++j) {
                memo_b[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
                memo_a[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
            }
        }
        
        solve();
        best_cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            if (s.charAt(i) == 'A') g[i] = 0;
            else if (s.charAt(i) == 'B') g[i] = 1;
        }
        solve();
        System.out.println(best_cnt);
    }
}
